title: m-control tool manifest (manifestVersion 1)
description: tools/<category>/<id>/manifest.json. Mirrors validateManifest in packages/core/src/discovery.ts; test/manifest-schema.test.ts keeps the two in agreement. The source of truth is ToolManifest in packages/core/src/types.ts.

manifestVersion.description: Schema version. A breaking change to the manifest bumps it.

id.description: Unique kebab-case id, used in `mctl run <id>`. Matches the tool's directory name.

runtime.description: Decides the spawn command: node -> the running Node, python -> python/python3, powershell -> powershell/pwsh, dotnet -> dotnet <dll> or the executable.

entry.description: Entry point, relative to this manifest (e.g. index.js, main.py, main.ps1).

requiredConfig.description: Dot-paths under the config's `tools` section the tool cannot work without. `mctl doctor` reports unset ones; the tool must still fail recoverably when one is empty.

optionalConfig.description: Dot-paths the tool reads when present. Only declared keys (required + optional) reach the tool.

timeoutMs.description: Run budget in ms. Precedence: config timeouts.tools[id] > timeoutMs > config timeouts.default > 30000.
